name: Ledor
tagline: Speed-read books and articles one word at a time
description:
Ledor is a speed reading app that flashes words to you one at a time in the same spot, a technique called RSVP, so your eyes don't have to move across the page. It works with EPUB books and web articles, and also offers a normal e-reader mode, scrolling mode, and text-to-speech if flashing words isn't your style.

It tracks your reading stats over time and can back up your library to your own Drive account.
